dataset_manifest.note: SHA-256 values are computed from the local payloads. Schema and view definition are read from each file.

federation.note: Matching origins, storey elevations, or bounding-box overlap do not verify element-level federation.

openings.opening_policy_note: Openings and void relationships are inventoried. Host occupancy keeps the host AABB. Opening solids are not subtracted, because subtracting an opening AABB can mark solid material as free.

placement_mesh_consistency.interpretation: Agreement between the once-scaled placement origin and the world mesh supports the metre frame. It does not by itself verify federation with another discipline file.

ports.native_placement_rule: A port coordinate is NATIVE_PORT_PLACEMENT only when its composed world point uses a non-identity local origin and lies near the host mesh. An identity local origin is not treated as a connection point.
